summary.text: Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage is an Immortal Gu House created by a mysterious rank seven Gu Immortal. It absorbs and seals attacks so the controller can strike back with them, and it was buried under a nameless mountain that rose from the battlefield.

claims.text: Bai Ning Bing activates a time path investigative Immortal Gu on a nameless mountain peak and watches Martial Duel Heavenly King, a rank eight with the Great Strength True Martial Physique, lose to a Gu Immortal who bears a red lotus mark on his forehead. Martial Duel Heavenly King turns into a rank eight immortal zombie; the controller cannot take his life and abandons the house to pin him deep under the earth before flying away.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile once raised, not a five-region map seat.

The house lies deep under the earth holding the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie in suppression, and it is strong enough that its power seeping to the outside is what forms the forbidden zone for immortals. The zombie has tried a killer move to refine the house with his battle will and failed, his soul dying thoroughly and leaving an empty shell of a body. Large quantities of that battle will remain in the house, purified by its strength into pure ownerless battle will, and whoever turns all of it into his own completes the last step the zombie left unfinished and becomes the house’s true owner.

Southern Border Gu Immortals later treat the house buried under Yi Tian Mountain as their hope against the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation, because of its defense against tribulations and its offense against the formation.
Fang Yuan judges it higher ranked than Hei tribe’s Dark Prison and notes that its construction seems to involve food path, so feeding is less of a problem than for many houses.

While Fang Yuan infiltrates Yi Tian Village in disguise, Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage is still holding the rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie in suppression and allowing it no freedom. The immortal zombie shows no sign of life at all, as though its soul has completely dissipated, but Fang Yuan does not probe it and instead spends his nights refining the house’s battle will.

When Sacred Feather City smashes down, Fang Yuan activates Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, calls it to rise, and is transported inside as Yi Tian Mountain crumbles. He is then officially controlling the house. Fed with yellow apricot immortal essence, its red light expands and he sends Sacred Feather City flying in one clash.

Fang Yuan later judges Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage a rank seven Immortal Gu House while contesting an iron fortress house that he also treats as likely rank seven and specialized in defense. Four Shadow Sect Immortal Gu Houses trap Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage so he cannot gather enough force to leave the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation. After Heaven Overseeing Tower unleashes a fate-backed white attack, Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage suffers the least damage among the houses on the field.
